boundaryCondition.description: A boundary condition of the adjoint velocity and pressure. For `normal_outflow`, `value` or `file_name` is required syntactically (neko src/bc/non_normal_aligned.f90:122-158 aborts without one), but the adjoint never uses the tangential data: the BC object is not appended to the velocity conditions and only its constraint masks are used (adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:1050-1060), so the adjoint tangential velocity on the zone is 0 and `p_adj` is 0 there (adjoint_fluid_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:90-91). A `file_name` is still imported and must exist.
boundaryCondition.$comment: Factories: sources/adjoint/adjoint_fluid_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:87-109 (pressure) and :149-191 (velocity); keys are read by Neko's boundary condition classes, so the Neko union is reused. `symmetry` (adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:1042), `shear_stress` (:1061-1064) and `wall_model` (:1065-1068) abort and are not listed. `user_velocity_pointwise` is a known type whose factory branch is commented out (adjoint_fluid_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:178): the zone counts as assigned and gets a natural condition instead of the requested one (adjoint_fluid_pnpn.f90:1028,1037), so it is not accepted. `name` is read only in Neko's own fluid BC factory (neko src/fluid/fluid_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:505,588), never by the adjoint factories, so it is rejected. `moving` is read only by Neko's no_slip_t (neko src/bc/no_slip.f90:72), while the adjoint builds a zero_dirichlet_t that reads no key, so it is rejected like `name`.

zone_indices.description: Zone indices, a literal array of JSON integers (a constants name is not accepted).

velocitySolver.description: Solver of the adjoint velocity. Each key that is absent here is read from `case.fluid.velocity_solver`.
velocitySolver.$comment: Neko's linear solver objects are open (registered Krylov types define their own keys), so this one is too. sources/adjoint/adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:211-336.

type.description: Krylov solver type. Falls back to `case.fluid.velocity_solver.type`.

absolute_tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance, a JSON real (no constants name).

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.fluid.velocity_solver.max_iterations`, else 1000.

monitor.description: Monitor the solve. Default `case.fluid.velocity_solver.monitor`, else false.

projection_space_size.description: Projection space size, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.fluid.velocity_solver.projection_space_size`, else 0.

projection_hold_steps.description: Projection hold steps, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.fluid.velocity_solver.projection_hold_steps`, else 5.

pressureSolver.description: Projection settings of the adjoint pressure solver; each key that is absent here is read from `case.fluid.pressure_solver`, and all other pressure solver keys come from there. Other keys are ignored.
pressureSolver.$comment: sources/adjoint/adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:215-229. Open like the other adjoint linear-solver objects and Neko's own: only the two projection keys are read here; every other key is ignored.

projection_space_size.description: Projection space size, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.fluid.pressure_solver.projection_space_size`, else 0.

projection_hold_steps.description: Projection hold steps, a JSON integer (no constants name). Default `case.fluid.pressure_solver.projection_hold_steps`, else 5.

adjointFluid.description: `case.adjoint_fluid`: the adjoint of the incompressible Navier-Stokes solver.

initial_condition.description: Initial condition of the adjoint fluid (required; reset every design iteration, with no fallback to `case.fluid`).

allOf.$comment: neko_ext.f90:356-373 (reset_adjoint) reads the type with no fallback and aborts on `user` (:372).

boundary_conditions.description: Adjoint boundary conditions; every labelled zone of the mesh needs exactly one.

freeze.description: No effect in a topology optimisation run: reset_adjoint overwrites the adjoint's freeze flag with `freeze_flow` before every adjoint run (neko_ext.f90:449-452, simulation.f90:423-426), so use `freeze_flow`. Read at initialisation (adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:231-233; default `case.fluid.freeze`).

freeze_flow.description: Freeze the adjoint flow at every design iteration. Default false.

source_term.description: Source terms of the adjoint momentum equation (note the singular key).
source_term.$comment: sources/adjoint/adjoint_fluid_scheme_incompressible.f90:368-370 -> neko src/source_terms/source_term_handler.f90:286-301. The state-dependent Neko types read the primal `u`, `v`, `w` (or the primal scalar) from the registry; they run on the adjoint right-hand side without an abort.

output_filename.description: Base name of the adjoint output. Default `adjoint`.

output_format.$comment: `adios2` (a .bp file) is not accepted: adjoint_case.f90:118 never assigns the local `layout` that :427 and :432 pass on, and neko src/io/bp_file.F90:829-833 aborts unless it happens to be 1-3. `case.output_layout` is never read by the adjoint.

output_control.description: When to write output. Default `never`. With `never` the adjoint field is still written once at the end of every adjoint run when `case.output_at_end` is true (the default), because simulation_adjoint_finalize forces a final write (simulation_adjoint.f90:102-104). The adjoint's output controller gets the end time only, so `case.output_at_start` does not apply to it (adjoint_case.f90:422).

output_value.description: Output frequency or interval, read for `tsteps`, `nsamples` and `simulationtime` only.

norm_output_control.description: When to write the adjoint norm. Default `never`.

norm_output_value.description: Interval of the norm output; read only when `norm_output_control` is not `never`. Default 1.0.

norm_output_file.description: File of the norm output, a `.csv` file. Default `adjoint_norm.csv`; read only when `norm_output_control` is not `never`.
norm_output_file.$comment: The norm is written as a vector_t (adjoint_case.f90:473-478, simulation_adjoint.f90:83,325-327), which only csv_file accepts: every other file_t type aborts on the first write ('Invalid data', neko src/io/fld_file.f90:306) or writes nothing (rea_file.f90:452-456).

allOf.$comment: adjoint_case.f90:452-459: tsteps and nsamples read an integer, simulationtime a real; both go through the constants lookup. A value must be positive (neko src/common/time_based_controller.f90:210-235). The requirement that output_value is present moves under `optimization` (see case-file), where the topology optimisation drivers read it.
adjoint_case.f90:445-458 reads output_value only for tsteps, nsamples and simulationtime.
adjoint_case.f90:471-477 reads norm_output_value and norm_output_file only when norm_output_control is not never.
neko src/common/time_based_controller.f90:232-235 aborts for a tsteps interval below 1 (adjoint_case.f90:471-472,480-481).
